content.text:
This project's docs (`src/docs/editor-setup.mdx`, "Class sorting with Prettier", lines 66–84) only describe the plugin at a high level and link out to the GitHub repo — they don't cover tagged-template-literal interpolation behavior or per-segment sorting.

That's a known limitation of the `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` sorter itself, not something documented in this repo: it sorts classes independently within each string segment between interpolations (`${...}`) rather than across the whole template literal, since it can't safely reorder text around a dynamic expression. This isn't a misconfiguration on your end — your `.prettierrc` setup is correct.
